lines.en: : This means you got a little reward for no payment at all {i}and{/i} I get to feel sexier from now on. We both win.
lines.zh: : 这意味着你没花一分钱就拿到了一点奖励，{i}而且{/i}我从今往后能觉得自己更性感了。我们双赢。

lines.en: : When do you think Yumi will be able to talk again?
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Yumi 什么时候才能重新开口说话？

lines.en: : Yumi? Probably the first time something annoys her. And since she’s with Chinami, maybe like...ten minutes?
lines.zh: : Yumi？大概是在有什么事惹到她的时候。既然她是跟 Chinami 在一起，也许……十分钟？

lines.en: : Fair enough.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: : Do we really have to eat lunch with them, though?
lines.zh: : 不过我们真的非得跟她们一起吃午饭吗？

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck23
: What? One helping of me wasn’t enough? You want to go find {i}another{/i} dressing room to fool around in?
lines.zh: : 什么？刚吃了我一次还不够？你想再去找{i}另一间{/i}试衣间胡搞？

lines.en: : No. But I would like to have a private conversation with you about something.
lines.zh: : 不是。但我想跟你私下谈一件事。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck24
: Another one?...
lines.zh: : 又一件？……

lines.en: : I don’t think it will take long, but it has to happen.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不会太久，但必须得谈。

lines.en: : And, since you managed to shoplift and save me some money, how about I buy you lunch after we’re done?
lines.zh: : 还有，既然你成功地顺手牵羊、替我省了点钱，等我们谈完我请你吃午饭怎么样？

lines.en: : ...Done?
: With the conversation.
lines.zh: : 谈完那件事。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: : Sure...
lines.zh: : 行吧……

lines.en: scene black
Chika and I split apart from Yumi and Chinami so they can go back to taco hunting.
lines.zh: Chika 和我跟 Yumi、Chinami 分开，好让她们继续去找卷饼。

lines.en: As it turns out, the two of them had spent the afternoon window shopping due to lack of money while Chika was off getting railed in a dressing room.
lines.zh: 原来，在 Chika 跑去试衣间里挨操的这段时间，那两个人因为没钱，整个下午都在逛橱窗。

lines.en: And, in other news, I think we can all agree that Chika had the better day.
lines.zh: 另外，我想我们都同意，Chika 这一天过得更好。

lines.en: Well, until now that is.
lines.zh: 好吧，到刚才为止是这样。

lines.en: But I guess we can wait until the two of {i}us{/i} get lunch to really make our final decision.
lines.zh: 不过我想，到底如何，可以等{i}我们俩{/i}吃完午饭再下最终结论。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck25
: Can you say something? This is making me really nervous...
lines.zh: : 你能说句话吗？这让我好紧张……

lines.en: : I’m trying to figure out how to say what I want to say in a way that won’t make you cry.
lines.zh: : 我在想，怎么把我想说的话说出来，才不会让你哭。

lines.en: : The more I think about it, though, the more I realize how hard that is to do.
lines.zh: : 但越想，我就越发现这很难做到。

lines.en: : Basically-
lines.zh: : 基本上-

lines.en: : You really need to slow down.
lines.zh: : 你真的需要慢下来。

lines.en: : Like...way down.
lines.zh: : 就是……大大地慢下来。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck26
: Slow...down?...
: Again, {i}way{/i} down.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，{i}大大地{/i}慢下来。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck27

lines.zh: : 所以……

lines.en: : You’re {i}not{/i} breaking up with me, then?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}不是{/i}要跟我分手了？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck28
: Oh, thank God. The second you told me you wanted to talk, I thought it was coming.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。你一说想谈谈，我还以为要来了。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck29
: Okay.
: I’ll do it.
lines.zh: : 我会的。

lines.en: : I’ll slow down. And I’ll be serious about it this time.
lines.zh: : 我会慢下来。而且这次我会认真去做。

lines.en: : Not just in school, but everywhere public. The mall, the...park? I don’t know. Anywhere the two of us meet that isn’t my apartment.
lines.zh: : 不只是学校，而是所有公共场所。商场、……公园？我不知道。任何我们俩碰面的地方，只要不是我的公寓。

lines.en: : As long as I have that...I’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 只要我能做到那个……我就没问题。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck30
: Honestly, almost getting caught by my sister back in the dressing room was...weirdly enough, kind of the wake up call I needed.
lines.zh: : 说实话，刚才在试衣间里差点被我妹妹抓包，……说来也怪，倒像是给了我当头一棒。

lines.en: : I’ve just...never had a boyfriend before. And I keep wanting to do stuff to impress you and...and stuff that I think will bring us closer together...
lines.zh: : 我只是……从来没有过男朋友。我总想做点什么让你刮目相看，还有……还有我觉得能让我们更亲近的事……

lines.en: : But...I didn’t even think about how clingy that may have made me seem. And I’m better than that. I {i}know{/i} I am.
lines.zh: : 可是……我根本没想过，那会让我看起来有多黏人。而我不该是那样的。我{i}知道{/i}我不是。

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 我{i}必须{/i}做到。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}have{/i} to be anything.
lines.zh: : 你{i}不必{/i}成为什么样子。

lines.en: : You accomplish more on your own than pretty much anyone else I know. I don’t expect you to be perfect 100%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 你一个人靠自己做到的事，比我认识的任何人都多。我不指望你 100%% 的时候都完美无缺。

lines.en: : If the world was okay with it, I’d be {i}fine{/i} with you clinging on to me all day long.
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界允许的话，你整天黏着我，我{i}一点都不介意{/i}。

lines.en: Another half truth- my specialty.
lines.zh: 又一句半真半假的话-我的拿手好戏。

lines.en: Frankly, I don’t care much about what the world thinks.
lines.zh: 坦白说，我不太在乎这个世界怎么想。

lines.en: But I {i}do{/i} care about what the people directly surrounding me- the ones I see every single day think.
lines.zh: 但我{i}确实{/i}在乎我身边的人——那些我每天都能见到的人——怎么想。

lines.en: Not in the sense that I want them to worry about me or anything as sentimental as that.
lines.zh: 不是说我想要他们为我担心之类那么煽情的意思。

lines.en: But in the sense that my life would be much more difficult if most of them were to find certain things out.
lines.zh: 而是说，要是他们中的大多数人知道了某些事，我的日子会难过得多。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Chika.
lines.zh: 对不起，Chika。

lines.en: And I’m sorry everyone else for having to hide all of this.
lines.zh: 也对其他所有人感到抱歉，因为不得不把这一切藏起来。

lines.en: Until recently, I never even imagined thinking something like that because, while many people struggle with apologizing, I struggle with even {i}wanting{/i} to.
lines.zh: 直到不久前，我甚至从没想过自己会冒出这样的念头，因为——虽然很多人不擅长道歉，但我连{i}想{/i}道歉都很难。

lines.en: It’s a part of myself I’m not proud of.
lines.zh: 这是我身上我自己也不喜欢的一部分。

lines.en: But, then again, there are very few parts of myself that I {i}am{/i} proud of.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我身上让我{i}感到{/i}自豪的部分也少之又少。

lines.en: So I should at least take solace in the fact that, right now, my heart is a little closer to the right place than it normally is.
lines.zh: 所以至少我该感到一丝安慰：此刻，我的心比平时稍微靠近了正确的位置一点点。

lines.en: Or at least I think so.
lines.zh: 或者至少我是这么想的。

lines.en: It's near impossible to ever confirm things like that.
lines.zh: 这种事几乎永远无法确认。

lines.en: : It’s just that, the more time we spend together...the riskier you’ve been making things.
lines.zh: : 只是，我们在一起的时间越长……你把事情弄得越冒险。

lines.en: : I don’t want you accidentally sabotaging something that I think both of us...really like.
lines.zh: : 我不想你一不小心毁掉一样……我觉得我们俩都……真的很喜欢的东西。

lines.en: scene chikawallfuck31
: Hearing you say it that way is...kind of like having the world lifted off of my shoulders.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说……有种如释重负的感觉。

lines.en: : Like, I never dreamed in a million years that I’d worry so much about a boy, but...
lines.zh: : 就像，我做梦都没想到自己会为一个男生操这么多心，可是……

lines.en: : I’ve fallen for you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我爱上你了，Sensei……

lines.en: : I’ve fallen really hard.
lines.zh: : 而且陷得很深。

lines.en: scene black
: Well-
: I’m glad the fall didn’t kill you.
lines.zh: : 很高兴这一跤没把你摔死。

lines.en: I buy Chika lunch, as promised.
lines.zh: 我如约请 Chika 吃了午饭。

lines.en: She stays five to ten feet away for the rest of the afternoon.
lines.zh: 那天下午剩下的时间里，她都跟我保持着五到十英尺的距离。
